upstream_api_review.spec_delta_from_previous_binding: Additive over 0.9.0-rc.14: client operations 108 -> 113 with GET /episodes/{id} (one episode, same shape as the /media/{id}/children items), GET /persons/{id} (PersonDetail: biography, birthday, deathday, place_of_birth, details_state), GET /media/{id}/images (MediaGallery: backdrops and posters, each with index, url, width, height and language), GET /media/{id}/videos (MediaVideoList: YouTube and Vimeo trailer and featurette links) and GET /media/{id}/extras (MediaExtraPage: local trailers and extras as classified Version objects). Image routes accept index; the poster route accepts season. Media adds the required keys tagline, tmdb_status, status, premiere_date, studios, collection and has_backdrop; Episode adds runtime_minutes, duration_ms, still and rating; Season adds has_poster; VersionDetail adds chapters (nullable VersionChapters), markers (SkipMarkers intro/recap/credits/preview derived from chapter titles) and extra. Local extras and trailers are no longer listed as versions of their work. Capability features add episode_by_id, media_detail_facts, person_details, media_image_gallery, media_videos, season_posters, episode_ratings, version_chapters and media_extras; no new limits. No typed SDK schema change: the typed Media reads only its existing fields.
